QuestInfo.name: Dragon Master's Treasure Chest
QuestInfo.0: The Administrator says that she will give anyone who hatches a Mini Dragon Egg the chance to obtain some precious treasures.\n
QuestInfo.1: You can receive the Onyx Dragon Treasure Chest from the Administrator by bringing her all 7 symbols of the Ancient Onyx Dragon. You can find symbols of the Ancient Onyx Dragon inside the Evan Gift Box given by Cassandra.
QuestInfo.2: You received the Onyx Dragon Treasure Chest from the Administrator. Rumor has it that it belonged to an ancient Dragon Master.
QuestInfo.summary: Collect the 7 symbols of the Ancient Onyx Dragon.

0.0: Wow! You hatched the Mini Dragon Egg. I have some information that can only be revealed to those who have hatched a Mini Dragon Egg. Want to hear?
0.1: Have you heard about the Onyx Dragon Treasure Chest, which contains treasures left by an ancient Dragon Master? If you collect 7 symbols of the Ancient Onyx Dragon and bring them to me, I will give you a chance to get one of those treasures!
0.2: Do you want to try to get an Onyx Dragon Treasure Chest?

yes.0: I'll give you one of the symbols of the ancient Onyx Dragon, the Baby Onyx Dragon Horn. Now, please collect the remaining 6 symbols and bring them to me.
yes.1: You can get the remaining 6 symbols from Evan's Gift Box, which is given by Cassandra to anyone who's hatched a Mini Dragon Egg!

no.0: That is sad to hear. If you want to obtain an Onyx Dragon Treasure Chest, be more courageous!

1.0: Wow, you collected all 7 symbols of the Ancient Onyx Dragon. Please take this Onyx Dragon Treasure Chest.

yes.0: I gave you the Onyx Dragon Treasure Chest as I promised. Inside, you will find an awesome treasure that was once used by an ancient Dragon Master.

item.0: You haven't collected all 7 symbols of the Onyx Dragon. Press 'Q' to find out which symbols you still need.
